headline: Senior Data Platform Architect | Healthcare & Regulated Industries | Cloud-Native Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) | PBM, Claims, HIPAA | Canonical Data Models
summary:
I design and deliver cloud-native data platforms that turn complex, regulated data landscapes into trusted, reusable assets — with deep expertise in healthcare (PBM, claims processing, eligibility, HIPAA) and financial services.

My platforms are event-driven and configuration-driven. Canonical data models and DSL-based ingestion abstract source system complexity — SAP, Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, legacy systems — so downstream clinical, operational, and analytical use cases can move fast without re-solving integration problems every time. I've built and scaled these platforms across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including hyperscaler-agnostic architectures that deploy to any cloud without re-engineering.

Healthcare is where this architecture delivers the most value. When you're unifying PBM claims data, eligibility feeds, and clinical records across heterogeneous source systems, a canonical data model isn't just a technical artifact — it's the compliance and governance layer that ensures only trusted data reaches consumers. I've applied this approach across PBM platforms, healthcare provider systems, financial services (global futures clearing), and supply chain operations.

I lead as a servant-leader. I've directly coached 40+ professionals into senior roles — and I measure success not by the platform I deliver, but by whether the client team can own and extend it independently after I leave.

Currently integrating agentic AI into data platform workflows — automating data quality validation, intelligent ingestion orchestration, and compliance monitoring for healthcare and regulated environments.

Core capabilities:
• Healthcare data platforms (PBM, claims, eligibility, NCPDP, HIPAA, X12 EDI)
• Cloud-native architecture (Azure, AWS, GCP)
• Canonical data model design and operationalization
• Event-driven / configuration-driven platform architecture
• Data governance and regulatory compliance
• Cross-functional leadership and client enablement

• Operationalized platforms with client teams for independent ownership and extension to new use cases
